chapter: Dancing schools and Charlie Johnson in New York
title: How McRae moved between Johnson's Atlantic City and New York jobs
summary: He played with Johnson in Atlantic City for a summer and returned to Small's Paradise for the winter in New York.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: So, you played with Charlie Johnson sort of on and off in Atlantic City, Philadelphia --

I played with him a little bit in Atlantic City one summer, yeah. That summer when I came up to join the club over at 5th. I played over here -- with a gig with him in the Paradise for somebody's place (inaudible). But then, when I went to Atlantic City again that summer, to work in another little club down there, there was some guys down there who had a band, you know. And I left that club and Charlie Johnson wanted me to come over and play with him at the Paradise after (inaudible). Somebody had got sick, so I worked about a couple of months over there with him in Atlantic City. But when I came back to New York that winter, I went down and I worked that whole winter with him in New York, The Paradise.
